title: Kenny Kersey and Illinois Jacquet
summary: Dance and Cootie recall Kenny Kersey, a boogie-woogie pianist, who went with Andy Kirk.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: So, yeah. We were talking about Pearl, and then I wanted to ask you, there were some other guys that you had. You had Kenny Kersey playing piano for awhile.
Yeah. I had Kenny Kersey with me for awhile.
No, I think that was before Bud Powell.
Did you like the way he played?
Yeah. He was a boogie woogie piano player.
Yeah. He had a good beat. He could swing.
Yeah. But I guess he was limited, somewhat, huh?
Well, that was just what he liked.
Yeah. He went with Andy Kirk. Andy Kirk Craig took him as a piano player.
Oh, did he? Oh. Is that right. Well, I tell you who I didn't talk to you about. But before that, let's just check and see if this is all right.
